//: Declarations that read the simulation through real subjects and properties (05 §5, §6). No rule uses them yet: they are here so that the linter checks the bundled content against the engine's own registry.
doc: How many times someone has come to stand in the tract. Kept on the tract's record, so it is remembered while the tract is not loaded.
How devastated the tract someone stands in is, 0 to 255. Zero for someone who is not in the world.
Whether the tract someone stands in has been visited at least so many times.
Whether a cell can be stood in with nothing in the way.
